problems.problem: No operational problems relevant to ForgeX's home-service contractor offerings are observable on the public website.
problems.label: inference
problems.basis: Based on https://ascending-it.com/ and https://ascending-it.com/managed-it-support-boise/, Ascending IT is a Managed IT Service Provider (MSP) with its own technical staff, ticketing portal, payment portal, and 24/7 monitoring capabilities.

existingSolutions.solution: Client ticketing and payment portals (onsitesvcs.itclientportal.com and on-sitesvcs.connectboosterportal.com)
existingSolutions.addresses: Customer support ticket tracking and billing/payment collection

feasibility.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended because Ascending IT is a B2B Managed IT Services and Cybersecurity provider outside ForgeX's target segment of home-service contractors.

risks.description: Pursue-level outreach to an IT managed services provider for contractor-focused field-service automation would be misaligned with their business model and internal technical capabilities.

assumptions: The website does not publish dollar prices for its Silver, Gold, or Platinum packages, stating instead that pricing depends on the number of users, devices, and services needed.
Because the company is outside ForgeX's target segment and no prices are shown on the site, commercial value is not calculated.

sourcesUsed.usedFor: Business identity, Nampa address, phone number, core IT and cybersecurity services, service packages, and referenced portal/script hosts.
Company mission, nationwide service scope, and compliance support details.
Contact information, 24/7 support availability, and contact form verification.
Checking terms page for legal entity name or registration details and embedded scripts.
Detailed breakdown of managed IT services, co-managed IT, vCIO offerings, and pricing structure explanation.
Detailed breakdown of cybersecurity services and compliance offerings.

limitations: The website does not name any owners, executives, or managers on the pages read.
The website does not disclose employee headcount or service pricing figures.
The Terms and Conditions page dynamically loads policy text via a third-party script (policies.termageddon.com) which does not render static text in the fetcher.

qualification.rationale: ForgeX targets owner-led home-service contractors (HVAC, plumbing, and electrical) with 10 to 75 staff. Ascending IT is a B2B Managed IT Services and Cybersecurity provider (MSP) that manages IT infrastructure, cloud systems, and security for commercial clients and already operates its own ticketing and payment portals.
